result_summary.title: Payment Gateway v2 configuration not applying in ME development environment
result_summary.description: In our Middle East development environment, changes made to the Payment Gateway v2 configuration are not taking effect. Despite saving the updates successfully, the gateway continues to operate with the old settings. Additionally, we are detecting significant config drift between the intended state and the actual running configuration. This mismatch is impacting 678 users who are testing new payment flows, causing high business impact as these tests are failing.
